Definition: from a compound of G2596 and G2233; a guide, i.e. (figuratively) a teacher:--master.
BiblicalUsage: Neither be ye called masters, for one is your Master, even Christ.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe there is one Master in the church, and every other title is borrowed.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
